name: Vagif Aliyev
current_role: Owner, Mandarin Plaza (Kyiv commercial real estate developer)
profile: Ukrainian businessman (Vagif Akhmedovich Aliyev), born 1959 in Ashgabat. After 1990s barter trade in Turkmen gas, he founded developer Mandarin Plaza (2000) and co-founded KAN (2001); he owns shopping centres and residential complexes in Kyiv. Ranked 18th richest in Ukraine in 2019 (NV/Dragon Capital).
interesting_fact: The developer KAN, which he co-founded in 2001 with Krapivin and Nikonov, was named from the initials of the three partners' surnames; its first Kyiv project was the Mandarin Plaza mall on Bessarabka (2003).
deep_cut_fact: In the late 1980s he built a soft-drink (sparkling water) sales network in his home city of Ashgabat before moving to Ukraine; he later earned a degree from the Kherson Institute of Business and Law in 2005.
notes: Wikidata Q97165485 matches (ukwiki: Алієв Вагіф Ахмедович). Very low public profile; Ukrainian Wikipedia lists him as an RF consul in Chernihiv from 2007 and Ukrainian media mention a Russian passport, so handle carefully. No published personal contacts found.

name: Victor Cha Mao Ching (Victor Cha Mou Zing, 查懋成)
current_role: Executive Chairman and Managing Director, HKR International Ltd (board effective 9 Oct 2026)
profile: Hong Kong property executive and son of Dr. Cha Chi Ming. He joined HKR International's board in 1989, became managing director (2001), deputy chairman (2007) and chairman (2020); his background spans property development and textile manufacturing. He is also a non-executive director of Mingly Corporation.
interesting_fact: He chairs the Hong Kong Arts Festival and has chaired the HKTDC's Hong Kong-Japan Business Co-operation Committee.
deep_cut_fact: He was a Sloan Fellow at Stanford University (MBA) and was named a University Fellow of the Hong Kong Polytechnic University in 2010.
notes: Current title confirmed via report of HKRI board structure effective 9 Oct 2026: https://www.itiger.com/news/1130580564 . HKRI website (hkri.com) blocked automated access, so no published press/IR email captured; best route is HKRI corporate communications or the Hong Kong Arts Festival.

name: Yu Jianwu
current_role: Chairman, Songdu Jiye Investment Co. (宋都基业, formerly Hangzhou Sundy/Songdu real estate group); chaired its board meeting on 29 Apr 2026
profile: Hangzhou property developer (俞建午) who built the Sundy/Songdu (宋都) real estate group, listed with Guo Yijuan on Hurun China 2010-2020. He was long chairman and president of Shanghai-listed 宋都股份 and founded Sundy Land Investment (2016). The company was delisted in 2024 and now trades on the NEEQ under 宋都5.
interesting_fact: Sundy is the English brand of 宋都 (Songdu); the group's property-services arm, Sundy Service Group, listed in Hong Kong (9608.HK). He also chaired Liaoning Baike Group from 2010 to 2012.
deep_cut_fact: He is listed as an executive member of the China Youth Entrepreneurs Association and a vice president of the Hangzhou Youth Entrepreneur Society.
notes: Sensitive: CSRC fined him in 2021 for insider trading in personal accounts; SSE censured the company in 2023; stock delisted in 2024 after trading below RMB1 (thepaper.cn: https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_23522128). 2026 board notice: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202605061821990160_1.pdf (company address: 宋都大厦, 789 Fuchun Rd, Hangzhou). Wealth likely much reduced.

name: Zhang Lingyun
current_role: Co-founder and major shareholder (~20.7%), iReader Technology (掌阅科技, SSE: 603533); listed by MarketScreener as former director
profile: Co-founded Beijing digital-reading company iReader (掌阅) with Cheng Xiangjun in September 2008. The two ran the company jointly until about 2021, and it listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017. Their concert-party agreement expired in Feb 2025 and was not renewed; Zhang still holds about 20.7% of the shares.
interesting_fact: Inside iReader he was the content builder: he championed the '掌阅公版' (iReader public-domain editions) project and invested heavily in copyright-management systems, while Cheng Xiangjun focused on channels.
deep_cut_fact: Per TMTPost, the name '掌阅' ('read in the palm') was chosen one night in 2008 by four young founders chatting in a bar at Beijing's Houhai; the company began charging for content from 2009.
notes: Low public profile; Lanjinger describes his presence fading after 2021, and he sold 8.6M shares in Nov 2024. Mailing address in the 2025 SSE disclosure is iReader's office (四惠大厦, Chaoyang, Beijing): https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-01/1222674658.PDF . Holding: https://uk.marketscreener.com/insider/LING-YUN-ZHANG-A29WRV/

name: Nie Quan
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, Shenzhen Liande Automation Equipment Co., Ltd. (联得装备, SZSE: 300545)
profile: Mechanical engineer and founder-chairman of Shenzhen automation-equipment maker Liande (联得装备), which makes production equipment such as bonding and laminating lines for flat-panel display modules. He was a main initial investor when its predecessor was set up in 2002, is its controlling shareholder, and still chaired its board in April 2026.
interesting_fact: In October 2025 he gave RMB 5 million to his alma mater, Hunan Institute of Technology, as a gift for its 50th anniversary, and he backs a 'Liande Class' (联得班) for school-enterprise training in intelligent manufacturing.
deep_cut_fact: He graduated from Hunan Institute of Technology in 1987 in machinery manufacturing process and equipment; at the donation he called it 'both a return to my alma mater and a gift for its 50th birthday' (既是对母校的回馈，也是对母校50华诞的献礼).
notes: Chairmanship confirmed in the April 2026 board notice: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202604221821454719_1.pdf . Best route is likely the Liande company board secretary (IR) office; no published email captured.

profile: Vice chairman and president of Inner Mongolia-based Jinyu Bio-Technology (animal biologics), listed on Hurun jointly with chairman Zhang Chongyu (张翀宇), who has led Jinyu since 1993. Born 1983, holds a master's degree and is a Hurun China U40 (2020) honoree; previously at Ernst & Young China, joined the company in 2015 and has been vice chairman and president since May 2022.

name: Zhao Jian
current_role: Former major (passive) shareholder of Ligao Foods (立高食品); not involved in management
profile: Founding-era shareholder of Guangzhou food company Ligao Foods (立高食品), whose predecessor was founded in 2000 and run by Peng Yuhui, Zhao Songtao and Peng Yongcheng. After the April 2021 listing he held 10.14% as third-largest shareholder; from 2022 he sold down for about RMB 1.185bn, holding 1.14% by May 2023 and planning a near-complete exit.
interesting_fact: Although a shareholder since the company's founding, he never took part in running it; he invested on the strength of Peng Yongcheng's team's cream R&D and production expertise.
notes: Per the company (via TMTPost, 2023) he has settled overseas with no plan to return and is liquidating his domestic holdings. Very private; no public contacts. Weak podcast fit.

name: Tian Chou
current_role: Founder and former chairman/general manager of Guangdong Kennede Electrical (金莱特, SZSE: 002723, later renamed 广东小崧科技); current role unknown
profile: Jiangmen, Guangdong manufacturer who founded Jiangmen Kennede Lighting Factory in October 2000 and in 2007 set up Guangdong Kennede Electrical, maker of rechargeable backup lighting and rechargeable AC/DC fans, where he was chairman and GM. Kennede listed on the Shenzhen SME board in January 2014; control passed to a new investor in 2017.
interesting_fact: Kennede's core products were rechargeable backup lighting and rechargeable AC/DC dual-use fans; before the IPO he personally pledged to cover any losses if a planned factory relocation hurt the business.
deep_cut_fact: When Kennede was founded in 2007 he put in RMB 18.52m for 61.73%, over RMB 10m of it as his own product moulds (bought 2005-2007), independently valued and contributed as in-kind capital.
notes: Hurun pairing with Jiang Xiaorong (蒋小荣): IPO documents name them as joint actual controllers. In Oct 2017 a 29.99% stake was transferred to 华欣创力, ending their control. Low profile; no public contacts found.

name: Rashesh Chandrakant Shah
current_role: Chairman, Edelweiss Group / Edelweiss Financial Services Ltd (Mumbai)
profile: Indian financier (b. 1963) who co-founded Edelweiss with Venkat Ramaswamy in November 1995, after IIM Ahmedabad (MBA 1989), ICICI and Prime Securities. Unable to meet SEBI's Rs 5 crore capital requirement, Edelweiss started in PE syndication, M&A and advisory with three staff in a small Mumbai office and grew into a diversified financial group. In Feb 2026 he bought a further 2.1% of EFSL for Rs 236 crore.
interesting_fact: He was President of FICCI for 2017-18 and has served on the executive committees of the NSE and SEBI.
deep_cut_fact: He was the first in his family to attend an English-medium school; before his MBA he took a B.Sc. in statistics at KC College, Mumbai, and spent a year studying exports at the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade, Delhi.
notes: Feb 2026 'Group Chairman' title and stake purchase: https://www.motilaloswal.com/news/stocks/117704 . The IR email was seen only in a search snippet of the Edelweiss IR page (the site returned 403 to direct fetch), so re-check it. The EdelGive Foundation (Edelweiss's philanthropy arm) is another angle. Wikipedia carries COI/paid-editing tags. Avoid the 2020 ED/Capstone matter.

name: Du Guoying
current_role: Founder, Xiaoguan Tea (小罐茶, Beijing Xiaoguan Tea Co.)
profile: Serial consumer-products marketer (杜国楹). He founded Tianjin Yipin Technology and the posture-corrector brand Beibeijia (背背佳) in 1997, the English-learning device Haojixing (好记星) in 2003, the E人E本 tablet and the 8848 titanium phone (2015), and then the premium tea brand Xiaoguan Tea (小罐茶).
interesting_fact: His product run is a generational memory in China: Beibeijia posture braces, Haojixing English gadgets, the E人E本 tablet (billed as 'China's iPad', with ads starring Feng Xiaogang and Ge You), the 8848 titanium phone and Xiaoguan Tea.
deep_cut_fact: He was a teacher until 1994, when at 21 he left to go into business; in 1995, posted to Tianjin, he ran his first radio ad and took his company's sales lead, which set off his advertising-led playbook.
notes: High-profile marketer; his companies have drawn advertising controversies (e.g. Beibeijia claims, Xiaoguan Tea's 2019 'master-made' row), so steer clear. No personal contacts published; route via Xiaoguan Tea corporate PR.

name: Lin Ping
current_role: Co-actual controller and (as of the 2012 IPO prospectus) director and purchasing manager, Wenzhou Hongfeng Electrical Alloy Co., Ltd. (温州宏丰, SZSE ChiNext: 300283); current role not confirmed
profile: Co-controller, with chairman Chen Xiao, of Wenzhou Hongfeng Electrical Alloy in Yueqing, Zhejiang, which makes electrical-contact composite materials and components. Born 1966, she ran purchasing from the company's early days (Yueqing Hongfeng, 1997) and joined the board in 2010; at the 2012 ChiNext IPO the couple held 89.68% directly (her direct stake 4.97%).
interesting_fact: Hongfeng's IPO money went to automated lines for layered and particle/fibre-reinforced electrical-contact composite materials, the small metal parts that make and break current in switches and relays.
deep_cut_fact: She has run Hongfeng's purchasing since September 1997, when the business was still Yueqing Hongfeng, and stayed purchasing manager through its 2010 conversion into a joint-stock company.
notes: Details from the 2012 IPO prospectus; current board status not verified (2024 annual report names Chen Xiao as company head). Very low profile; the best route is likely via Hongfeng's board secretary office.

name: Sir Mick Jagger
current_role: Lead singer, The Rolling Stones (new album 'Foreign Tongues', 2026)
profile: Born 1943 in Dartford, Kent; left the London School of Economics to front the Rolling Stones, and was knighted in 2003 for services to popular music. His wealth comes from six decades of recording and touring. In 2026 the Stones released 'Foreign Tongues', with guests incl. Paul McCartney and Robert Smith, and he has said he hopes to tour again 'as soon as possible'.
interesting_fact: He co-founded the film company Jagged Films in 1991 with Victoria Pearman; its first release was the 2001 drama 'Enigma'.
deep_cut_fact: He auditioned for Dr. Frank N. Furter in the 1975 'Rocky Horror Picture Show' film (Tim Curry got it) and was considered for the lead in Alejandro Jodorowsky's never-made 'Dune'; in January 2023 he launched his own line of harmonicas.
notes: 2026 album/touring status: https://ca.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/mick-jagger-the-rolling-stones-tour-interview-bbc/ (June 2026; 2026 UK/Europe stadium tour reportedly scrapped). Off-thesis for an energy/data-centre podcast; any approach would go through Stones management/publicists.

name: Zhu Chaoyang
current_role: Chairman (and controlling shareholder), Guangxi Liuzhou Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. (柳药集团, SSE: 603368)
profile: Guangxi pharma-distribution entrepreneur (b. Sept 1965, accountant by training) who built Liuzhou Pharmaceutical (柳药) from the state Liuzhou pharmaceutical wholesale station into a listed group. He is the controlling shareholder and actual controller, was re-elected to lead the sixth board in March 2026, and also presides over the Guangxi Pharmaceutical Chamber of Commerce.
interesting_fact: Liuyao has built a smart supply-chain automation project with Huawei and, per its June 2026 earnings briefing, plans further work with Huawei on disease-specific large AI models.
deep_cut_fact: He began as an accountant at the Liuzhou Pharmaceutical Wholesale Station and rose through finance-section deputy head and head to deputy manager and manager before leading the company as chairman and GM.
notes: Chaired the April 2026 board meeting: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202604291821762147_1.pdf . Also a Guangxi CPPCC member (bio updated 2023). The AI/supply-chain angle with Huawei could suit a tech/data-centre podcast. Route via Liuyao board secretary/IR.

name: Lin Ruowen
current_role: Vice Chairman and Chief Designer, Jinfa Labi Maternity & Baby Articles Co., Ltd. (金发拉比, SZSE: 002762; as of Dec 2022 board notice)
profile: Shantou, Guangdong entrepreneur (b. 1959) and co-controlling shareholder (25.95% in 2022) of Jinfa Labi, founded in 1996 and one of China's earliest designers and makers of infant clothing, cotton goods and daily-use products, which listed in Shenzhen in June 2015. She co-controls the company with chairman Lin Haoliang and serves as vice chairman and chief designer.
interesting_fact: Unusually for a listed-company controller she holds the title 'Chief Designer'; she is also vice-chair of the China National Garment Association's children's-wear committee (3rd term).
deep_cut_fact: She has been honoured as an 'Outstanding Woman Entrepreneur in China' (全国杰出创业女性) by the China Association of Women Entrepreneurs and as a Guangdong 'March 8th Red-Banner Holder'; she is vice president of the Shantou Women Entrepreneurs Association.
notes: Company background: https://pitchhub.36kr.com/project/2079297107728134 . The company is now traded as *ST金比 (loss-making in 2025), so steer clear of that topic. Current 2026 title not re-verified (a third-party page shows her vice-chair term ending Dec 2025). Route via the company's board secretary.

name: David Blood
current_role: Founding Partner and Senior Partner, Generation Investment Management (London); Chair, World Resources Institute Global Board
profile: Former Goldman Sachs banker (18 years, including CEO of Goldman Sachs Asset Management) who in April 2004 co-founded the London sustainable-investment firm Generation Investment Management with Al Gore and five other partners. He also chairs Just Climate (Generation's climate-solutions investing platform), Social Finance UK and the World Resources Institute.
interesting_fact: Generation was founded by seven partners led by Al Gore and Blood, then the former head of Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and describes itself as 'a pure-play sustainable investment manager. It is all we do.'
deep_cut_fact: Alongside his climate roles he sits on the board of the wildlife charity On the Edge Conservation and chairs Social Finance UK; he studied at Hamilton College (BA) before Harvard Business School.
notes: Strong fit for an energy/climate-investing podcast; Just Climate is directly relevant to energy transition. Press enquiries for Generation go via Kekst CNC as published on the firm's contact page.

name: J Patrick Gallagher Jr
current_role: Chairman, President and CEO, Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. (NYSE: AJG)
profile: Grandson of the founder of insurance broker Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. He interned there in 1972, joined full time in 1974 as a production account executive, became VP Operations (1985), President & COO (1990), CEO (1995) and Chairman (2006). Cornell BA in Government; long active on Chicago civic and insurance-education boards.
interesting_fact: In 2007 he was granted the Freedom of the City of London for his contributions to the Lloyd's insurance market and support of the Gallagher Lifelong Learning scholarships.
deep_cut_fact: His first full-time job at the family firm (1974) was Production Account Executive, after a 1972 internship; he was named Reactions magazine's 'Insurance Broking CEO of the Year' in 2013.
notes: Current title per AJG executive-team page as surfaced in search (https://www.ajg.com/us/about-us/executive-team/); AJG IR site blocked automated fetch so no IR/press email captured. Route via AJG corporate communications.

name: Katy Perry
current_role: Singer-songwriter and performer; co-founder of non-alcoholic aperitif brand De Soi
profile: Born Katheryn Hudson (1984, Santa Barbara), she became a pop star with 'I Kissed a Girl' (2008) and 'Teenage Dream'. Her wealth comes from music (catalog rights sold to Litmus Music in 2023 for an estimated $225m), touring and ventures such as De Soi (2022). The 2025 Lifetimes Tour played 91 shows grossing $134m+; in 2026 she performed at the World Cup opening ceremony.
interesting_fact: On 14 April 2025 she flew to space on Blue Origin's NS-31, the first all-female spaceflight since 1963.
deep_cut_fact: Her debut was a 2001 gospel album, 'Katy Hudson', recorded at 16 for Red Hill Records; it sold an estimated 200 copies before she took her mother's maiden name, Perry, as a stage name.
notes: Entrepreneurship angle: De Soi (co-founded Jan 2022 with Morgan McLachlan) and an early Popchips investor/spokesperson role. As of Sept 2026 she is working on the animated film 'Melody'. Any approach goes through her management/publicists.
